articles.title: Why Is Yokohama Rubber Company (TSE:5101) Getting Fresh Attention?
articles.summary: Yokohama Rubber Company (TSE:5101) has drawn investor attention after its recent share price moves, including a gain over the past week but declines over the past month and past 3 months. At ¥7,003 per share, Yokohama Rubber Company has seen short term momentum cool, with the share price return down 6.81% over the past month and 5.89% over 3 months.
